{{Top|leg|title=Unidentified ''maitre d'''}}
{{Conjecture|legends}}
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Stone Grotto]] dinner club on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bothawui/Legends|Bothawui]] was overseen by a '''''maitre d'''''', who among other things, took care that the restaurant's dress code was maintained, and even would offer articles of clothing to customers.

He welcomed a group of undercover [[Alliance Intelligence/Legends|Alliance Intelligence]] [[operative]]s to the [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurant]] in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3 ABY/Legends|3.5 ABY]]. As many other locals, he mistook [[Unidentified courier lookalike|one of them]] for a [[Unidentified crime syndicate courier|crime syndicate courier]]; when the operative corrected him, he complied, but still thinking it was part of his cover.

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The adventure notes that the Stone Grotto has a strict [[Clothing/Legends|dress]] code and that the ''maitre d''' will offer the players a suitable jacket, tie, or [[Scarf/Legends|scarf]] to wear if they arrive at the restaurant improperly clothed. The articles of clothing will not fit, but the players will not be allowed to enter if they do not put them on.
